mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST drops > 10% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS decreases and UNRATE increases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases > 5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 decreases > 1% in 1 quarter.
